project_info.theme: Shopee Philippines cash grand draw winners poster
project_info.color_palette: Bright orange, yellow gold, white, red

main_subject.detail: A celebratory orange poster for a Philippines campaign. Large top text reads '7.7 SHOPEE ALL-OUT MEGA CASH PANALO'. A gold rounded banner says 'GRAND DRAW WINNERS OF' and the huge central prize reads '₱1,000,000'. A rounded orange-gold winner board lists the usernames 'venice1208', 'lourdesbautistamiguel', 'timothy_bon22', and 'inaharbolo'. The bottom left fine print says 'Check In to Win ₱1,000,000 on July 7 only. T&C apply. Per DTI Fair Trade Permit No. FTEB-261237, 261302 Series of 2026'. Bottom footer shows the Shopee logo and 'CHECK SHOPEE FIRST'.
main_subject.style: Bright celebratory prize-announcement poster with oversized cash typography, floating coins, and gift-box props

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Shopee Philippines cash-prize campaign. Centerpiece is a giant orange-gold announcement board with the headline '7.7 SHOPEE ALL-OUT MEGA CASH PANALO', a gold banner 'GRAND DRAW WINNERS OF', and huge prize text '₱1,000,000'. Background is a bright orange radial burst with floating money bills, Shopee coin icons, and gift-box stacks. Surrounding elements: winner list 'venice1208', 'lourdesbautistamiguel', 'timothy_bon22', 'inaharbolo', legal line 'Check In to Win ₱1,000,000 on July 7 only. T&C apply. Per DTI Fair Trade Permit No. FTEB-261237, 261302 Series of 2026', Shopee logo, and footer slogan 'CHECK SHOPEE FIRST'. Technical style: promotional cash-prize poster with bold graphic compositing, high-energy celebratory lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
